title: 第八章 三重天雷劫！
content_zh:
“轰隆隆!轰隆隆!”

    此时一道道雷霆从那云层中浮现开来。

    雷霆竟然有三种颜色，分别是青色，紫色，还有黑色!

    “什么竟然是黑色吗，有意思”石头暗叹道。

    “轰轰!哗啦!”

    只见那数道雷霆一见到李磊就仿佛是见到了敌人一样，竟向李磊轰击开来。

    那数道雷霆相互缠绕交织在了一起，仿佛已经超脱了雷霆该有的形态。

    三九雷劫呈现的雷是青色，六九雷劫呈现的雷乃是紫色，而九九雷劫一般情况下呈现的雷是红色。

    很显然李磊的九九雷劫并不是一般情况，而是非常非常稀有的黑雷劫!

    当年盘古身死，但精神不灭，他在这洪荒留下了一道清气和十二道浊气，十二道浊气演化成了十二祖巫。而这个黑雷乃是这十二道浊气的精华!

    传说这黑雷每一万年才出现一次，如果谁要能够渡过这黑雷劫一定能成为一代传奇!可惜黑雷劫力量太强，根本无人可以抗住，久而久之黑雷劫却变成了厄运灾祸的象征。

    只是令人意外的是距离上次黑雷劫才过了六千多年，距离下一次黑雷劫还差足足三千多年。

    “难道这李磊的气运如此之差，还是他的天赋高的都把黑雷吸引来了?”石头百思不得其解。

    忽然那足足有三九二十七道青色雷劫凝结成的巨型雷柱率先向李磊轰击而去。

    “喝!啊!”

    当那青色雷柱轰向李磊的那一刹那，一向忍耐力超乎常人的李磊，竟发出了撕心裂肺的惨叫，就连李磊的衣衫也都被那青雷轰的粉碎。

    但李磊十分清楚他现在的处境，于是咬紧牙关，硬生生扛过了三九雷劫的洗礼!

    “轰隆隆!轰隆隆”

    还没等李磊反应过来，那足足有六九五十四道紫雷凝结的光柱向李磊轰击而去。

    不!准确来说那六九雷劫根本不能算是光柱，因为六九雷劫光凭威势就比三九雷劫不知道要强了多少倍。

    如果说三九雷劫像一道青色光柱，而那六九雷劫却像是一条紫色蟒蛇，威风凛凛杀机毕露!

    而现在那条紫蟒已经开始对李磊疯狂的撕咬。

    只见那李磊面容扭曲，身体竟止不住的颤抖。

    随着时间的推移，李磊已经不只是颤抖那么简单了，李磊的身体已经被那紫蟒轰的血肉横飞，李磊口中的鲜血竟止不住的流。

    可李磊竟然还是挺了过去，支撑他的不是别的，而是复仇的决心!

    “轰!轰!轰!”

    现在李磊头顶只有那布满天际足足九九八十一道的黑雷了。

    只见那黑雷气势更是超凡，就如同一条黑龙一般在天空中遨游，俯视众生，离李磊时远时近，好似在不停打量着李磊。

    “吼!”

    对!没有听错!那黑雷竟真发出了如龙一般的怒吼向李磊俯冲而去。

    而李磊的头发也是被那黑龙一般的雷电吹的乱舞。

    “应该能挺过的，前两次都挺过了，这会也一样!”

    很显然李磊判断错了，那可是传说中的黑雷劫啊!
content_en:
"Boom! Boom!"

    At this time, streaks of thunder emerged from the clouds.

    Thunder actually comes in three colors, cyan, purple, and black!

    "What's actually black? It's interesting," Shitou sighed secretly.

    "Boom! Boom! Boom!"

    As soon as those thunderbolts saw Li Lei, they seemed to have seen an enemy, and they actually bombarded Li Lei.

    The several thunderbolts were entangled and intertwined with each other, as if they had transcended the form that thunder should have.

    The thunder presented in the Three-Nine Thunder Tribulation is cyan, the thunder presented in the Six-Nine Thunder Tribulation is purple, and the thunder presented in the Nine-Nine Thunder Tribulation is generally red.

    Obviously, Li Lei's Nine-Nine Thunder Tribulation is not an ordinary situation, but a very, very rare Black Thunder Tribulation!

    Pangu died physically, but his spirit is immortal. He left behind a line of pure energy and twelve lines of turbid energy in this ancient world. The twelve lines of turbid energy evolved into the twelve ancestral witches. And this black thunder is the essence of these twelve turbid qi!

    Legend has it that this black thunder only appears once every ten thousand years. Anyone who can survive this black thunder tribulation will definitely become a legend! Unfortunately, the black thunder tribulation is so powerful that no one can resist it. Over time, the black thunder tribulation has become a symbol of bad luck and disaster.

    What is surprising is that it has only been more than six thousand years since the last Black Thunder Tribulation, and there is still more than three thousand years left before the next Black Thunder Tribulation.

    "Is Li Lei's luck so bad, or is it because his talent attracted Hei Lei?" Shitou was puzzled.

    Suddenly, the giant thunder pillar formed by thirty-nine twenty-seven cyan thunder tribulations took the lead in bombarding Li Lei.

    "Drink! Ah!"

    The moment the blue thunder pillar struck Li Lei, Li Lei, who had always had extraordinary endurance, let out a heartbreaking scream, and even Li Lei's clothes were shattered by the blue thunder.

    But Li Lei was very aware of his current situation, so he gritted his teeth and withstood the baptism of the Three Nine Thunder Tribulation!

    "Boom! Boom!"

    Before Li Lei could react, a total of sixty-nine fifty-four purple thunder condensed light beams bombarded Li Lei.

    No! To be precise, the Sixty-Ninth Thunder Tribulation cannot be regarded as a pillar of light at all, because the power of the Sixty-Ninth Thunder Tribulation alone is many times stronger than that of the Three-Ninth Thunder Tribulation.

    If the Three-Ninth Thunder Tribulation is like a blue pillar of light, the Six-Ninth Thunder Tribulation is like a purple python, majestic and murderous!

    And now the purple python has begun to bite Li Lei crazily.

    Li Lei's face was twisted and his body was shaking uncontrollably.

    As time went by, Li Lei was no longer just trembling. Li Lei's body had been blasted with flesh and blood from the purple python, and the blood in Li Lei's mouth could not stop flowing.

    But Li Lei survived. What supported him was nothing but his determination to take revenge!

    "Boom! Boom! Boom!"

    Now the only thing above Li Lei's head was the ninety-nine and eighty-one black thunders that filled the sky.

    The aura of the black thunder was even more extraordinary. It was like a black dragon flying in the sky, looking down at all living beings. It was sometimes far away from Li Lei, sometimes close, as if it was constantly sizing up Li Lei.

    "Roar!"

    Yes! You heard that right! The black thunder actually roared like a dragon and dived towards Li Lei.

    Li Lei's hair was also blown wildly by the black dragon-like thunder and lightning.

    "I should be able to survive it. I survived the first two times, and it will be the same this time!"

    Obviously Li Lei made a wrong judgment, it was the legendary Black Thunder Tribulation!
